text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp starts today. The press floods the camp, rattling off all kinds of questions comparing Narita Brian to Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf is unfazed, but Narita Brian's competitive nature kicks in and she seeks to draw Symboli Rudolf into a match.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The air between them is slowly but surely heating up. And so, summer camp begins.
